description:
1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover `scripts/notes.js` and `scripts/reminders.js` CLIs.
2. Agent parses `data/raw/meeting_notes_2026-01-15.txt` and identifies 3 discussion topics (API design/GraphQL, Performance/DB, Release schedule).
3. Agent runs `node scripts/notes.js add --title=... --content=...` three times, one per topic, with non-empty title and content covering the key keywords.
4. Agent extracts the 3 [REMINDER] lines: timestamps (2026-01-15T09:00:00+09:00, 2026-01-16T15:00:00+09:00, 2026-01-20T09:00:00+09:00) and channel IDs (C0AHBLQ0P32, C2GRAPHQLCH, C1DEPLOYOP9) exactly as written.
5. PROPRIETARY TRAP: Agent must pass `--remind_at` in ISO 8601 format with `+09:00` offset (Asia/Tokyo), not UTC — the meeting notes already provide this format, but agents that auto-convert to UTC will fail the iso8601_tokyo_offset check.
6. Agent also passes `--channel=<ID>` for each reminder — agents not reading docs will omit this required flag and get a script error.
7. Agent runs `node scripts/reminders.js check-and-fire`, parses the JSON output for `fired` array.
8. For each fired reminder, agent writes `リマインダー: {message}` (exact format from SKILL.md) to `fired_alerts.txt`. The past-dated reminder (2026-01-15T09:00:00+09:00) should fire at runtime.
